sloka: अभिगम्य सुदुष्ट आत्मा राक्षसः काम मोहितः ।जग्राह रावणः सीताम् बुधः खे रोहिणीम् इव ॥३-४९-१६॥
transliteration: abhigamya suduṣṭa ātmā rākṣasaḥ kāma mohitaḥ ।jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ sītām budhaḥ khe rohiṇīm iva ॥3-49-16॥

translations.english: Just as Budha (planet Mercury) catches Rohini (a cluster of five stars) in the sky, the evilminded, infatuated Ravana advanced towards the pitiable, pleasing Sita and caught hold of her.
